title: Long-Term Artist Residency
includes: 60 cu. ft. Train wood fire kiln
25 cu. ft. Cross Draft wood/gas/soda/salt kiln
cost_text: Monthly rent $1200 with utilities; work exchange options available
commitment: 10-12 months, starting July, August, or September
summary: A 10-12 month residency with access to wood-fire, soda, and gas kilns. Residents participate in firings and help manage the property. Applications for 2026 closed; rolling applications for 2027-2028.
source_quote: Long-term residencies typically start in September. Short-term residencies typically take place between June-August. Residents have access to a variety of kilns and resources through-out the year, including: 250 cu. ft. Anagama kiln, 60 cu. ft. Train wood fire kiln, 25 cu. ft. Cross Draft wood/gas/soda/salt kiln
evidence_quote: Residents have access to a variety of kilns and resources through-out the year, including: 250 cu. ft. Anagama kiln, 60 cu. ft. Train wood fire kiln, 25 cu. ft. Cross Draft wood/gas/soda/salt kiln
evidence_sentence: Long-term residents have year-round access to wood-fire, soda, salt, and gas kilns.
how_to_join: Email cobbartandecology@gmail.com with portfolio and application materials
